title: Automated Covariate Fetching for Plot2Map
text: Multi-source data integration: Download ESA CCI, GLAD, RESOLVE, UMD GLCF, CGIAR-CSI, Intact Forests One-line workflows: Single function fetch stack covariates Reproducible pipelines: Standardized spatial processing (crop, resample, aggregate) Parallel downloads: Speed data acquisition multi-core support Smart caching: Avoid redundant downloads local file management

title: Automated Covariate Fetching for Plot2Map
text: Install development version GitHub:
code: # install.packages("devtools") devtools::install_github("aTnT/spatialcovariates")

title: Automated Covariate Fetching for Plot2Map
text: simplest workflow uses getBiasCovariates() download stack environmental covariates:
code: library(spatialcovariates)  # Define region of interest (example within Mexico) mexico_bbox <- c(xmin = -101, ymin = 20.5, xmax = -100.5, ymax = 21)  # Fetch all covariates at 10km resolution covariates <- getBiasCovariates(   extent = mexico_bbox,   year = 2010,   resolution = "10km",   n_cores = 4  # Use 4 cores for parallel downloads )  # View the stack terra::plot(covariates) names(covariates) # [1] "agb"          "tcc2010"      "biome"        "treecover2000" # [5] "elevation"    "slope"        "aspect"       "tri" # [9] "tpi"          "roughness"    "ghm"          "ifl"

title: Automated Covariate Fetching for Plot2Map
text: Use fetched covariates directly Plot2Map workflows:
code: library(Plot2Map)  # Prepare covariate list (excluding AGB which is passed separately) covariate_list <- list(   tcc2010 = covariates[["tcc2010"]],   biome = covariates[["biome"]],   treecover2000 = covariates[["treecover2000"]],   slope = covariates[["slope"]],   aspect = covariates[["aspect"]],   ifl = covariates[["ifl"]] )  # Extract bias covariates for your plot data # Note: Assumes plot_data has columns: x, y, plotAGB_10, mapAGB bias_data <- extractBiasCovariates(   plot_data = my_field_plots,   map_agb = covariates[["agb"]],  # AGB map raster   map_sd = NULL,                   # Optional: standard deviation raster   covariates = covariate_list      # List of covariate rasters )

GLAD TCC 2010: Static dataset representing year 2010 tree canopy cover. ETH Canopy Height 2020: Static dataset representing year 2020 canopy height (10m resolution).     Requires rgee package Google Earth Engine account. Dinerstein Biomes: Static dataset (2017), temporal variation. Hansen GFC Tree Cover: Uses year 2000 baseline regardless year parameter. SRTM Terrain: Static DEM, temporal variation. Provides elevation     derived metrics (slope, aspect, TRI, TPI, roughness). Global Human Modification: Static dataset (2016), temporal variation. Requires rgee. IFL: Available 2000, 2013, 2016, 2020. Uses closest available year. Data Sources Data downloaded public sources. require API keys: ESA CCI: CEDA Archive GLAD TCC 2010: GLAD/UMD ETH Canopy Height 2020: Google Earth Engine (requires rgee + GEE account) Dinerstein: RESOLVE Ecoregions Hansen GFC: Google Cloud Storage SRTM: CGIAR-CSI gHM: Google Earth Engine (requires rgee + GEE account) IFL: Intact Forests

title: spatialcovariates: Automated Covariate Fetching for Plot2Map Bias Modeling — spatialcovariates-package
text: Provides automated functions fetch, process, stack environmental covariates commonly used Plot2Map workflows bias modeling uncertainty quantification. package focuses reproducibility downloading data reliable sources, clipping rasters user-specified extents, resampling target resolutions (e.g., 10 km match ESA CCI AGB maps). Supports multiple data sources including ESA CCI Biomass, Global Forest Canopy Height, RESOLVE Ecoregions, Tree Cover datasets, SRTM terrain, Intact Forest Landscapes. spatialcovariates package provides automated functions fetch, process, stack environmental covariates commonly used Plot2Map workflows bias modeling uncertainty quantification.

title: spatialcovariates: Automated Covariate Fetching for Plot2Map Bias Modeling — spatialcovariates-package
text: package exports following main user-facing functions: getBiasCovariates Fetch stack covariates (recommended) getESACCIAGB Fetch ESA CCI Biomass AGB SD maps getGLADTCC2010 Fetch GLAD Tree Canopy Cover 2010 getETHCanopyHeight Fetch ETH Global Canopy Height 2020 (requires rgee) getDinersteinBiome Fetch RESOLVE Ecoregions biomes getHansenGFC Fetch Hansen Global Forest Change Tree Cover 2000 getSRTMTerrain Fetch SRTM terrain metrics (elevation, slope, aspect, TRI, TPI, roughness) getGlobalHumanMod Fetch Global Human Modification Index getIFL Fetch Intact Forest Landscapes
